verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm an llms.txt at getlago.com/llms.txt and markdown versions of doc pages (e.g. intro.md) that point agents to a docs-level llms.txt index. A machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 schema, which Lago's developer page pitches for exposing billing actions to AI agents, adds further agent-oriented material. Missing for 10: no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant, and no independent user reports of agents actually consuming these docs.
